title: An Empirically-grounded tool for Automatic Prompt Linting and Repair: A Case Study on Bias, Vulnerability, and Optimization in Developer Prompts

bias_targets.methodology: LLM-as-a-judge evaluation using a multi-shot hand-crafted prompt to detect explicit bias and bias-proneness in developer prompts, benchmarked against a dataset by Samory et al., and illustrated via counterfactual name substitutions in prompts.
